subject: Action Required: Update Your Account Information
body: Dear valued customer, We are reaching out to remind you to update your account information to ensure seamless service on our platform. It is important to keep your details up to date to prevent any interruptions or issues. Please log in to your account and navigate to the profile section to make any necessary changes. Thank you for your attention to this matter. If you encounter any difficulties, feel free to contact our customer support team for assistance.
